question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Requiring exceptional skill or caution in performance or handling
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tricky**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here are the meanings of the words: 
 
 
• **Blunt** (फूला हुआ) - not sharp or pointed; lacking sharpness or forcefulness.
 
• **Tricky** (चालाक) - requiring skill or caution because of difficulty, complexity, or deception; likely to change unexpectedly or be difficult to deal with.
